name: Ghost Cursor
description: WebGL smoke-like ghost trail that follows the pointer across its parent area, with bloom, grain, click puffs and a dark or light theme.
contents: Absolutely positioned overlay container filling the parent
WebGL2 canvas rendering a fluid-like trail simulation with bloom and grain
behavior: Trail of glowing smoke follows the pointer anywhere in the window and drifts and swirls with noise
Clicking or tapping emits a puff that expands outward when clickPuff is on
Plays an intro animation on mount when intro is on
Trail fades out after the pointer goes idle, with shorter delays on touch devices
Pauses when the tab is hidden and recovers from WebGL context loss
Resolution is scaled to a pixel budget and capped device pixel ratio
Does not render when WebGL2 or float color buffers are unavailable

props.name: mixBlendMode
props.default: undefined (screen for dark, normal for light)

editableByProps: Trail color, brightness, size, length, inertia, turbulence, drift and detail
Bloom strength, radius and threshold, grain and edge intensity
Click puff and intro toggles, fade delay and duration
Dark or light theme and blend mode
Performance limits through maxDevicePixelRatio and targetPixels
Stacking order, class names and inline style of the overlay

needsCodeEdit.change: Track the pointer only inside the parent instead of the whole window
needsCodeEdit.where: window pointermove and pointerdown listeners in the main useEffect

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the look of the smoke shape and shading
Change how the trail flows and swirls
Show a fallback when WebGL2 is unavailable
needsCodeEdit.where: The early return after canvas.getContext('webgl2') in the main useEffect

fixed: Requires WebGL2 with EXT_color_buffer_float, otherwise renders nothing
Sets the parent element to position relative when it is static and restores it on unmount
Needs a parent element with real size since the overlay fills it with absolute inset-0
Listens to pointer events on window and document for the whole page, not only the parent
Overlay is pointer-events-none so it never blocks clicks
Client component using the use client directive

options.look: Glowing additive smoke blended with screen mode
options.useWhen: Dark hero or full-page dark site where a glowing cursor trail should stand out

options.look: Smoke shaded for light backgrounds with normal blending
options.useWhen: White or pastel landing page needing a soft ink-like cursor trail
